        self.income_label = tk.Label(self.income_frame, text="Income")
        self.income_label.pack()

        self.income_listbox = tk.Listbox(self.income_frame)
        self.income_listbox.pack()

        self.add_income_button = tk.Button(self.income_frame, text="Add Income")
        self.add_income_button.pack()

        self.add_income_button.config(command=self.add_income)

        # Settings frame
        self.settings_label = tk.Label(self.settings_frame, text="Settings")
        self.settings_label.pack()

        self.settings_button = tk.Button(self.settings_frame, text="Settings")
        self.settings_button.pack()

        self.settings_button.config(command=self.settings)

        # Get user input
        date = self.date_entry.get()
        amount = self.amount_entry.get()
        category = self.category_entry.get()

        # Validate user input
        if not date or not amount or not category:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Please fill in all fields")
            return

        try:
            amount = float(amount)
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Invalid amount")
            return

        # Add expense to database
        self.cursor.execute("""
            INSERT INTO expenses (user_id, date, amount, category)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (self.user_id, date, amount, category))
        self.conn.commit()

        # Update expenses listbox
        self.expenses_listbox.insert(tk.END, f"{date} - {amount} - {category}")

    def add_income(self):
        # Get user input
        date = self.date_entry.get()
        amount = self.amount_entry.get()
        category = self.category_entry.get()

        # Validate user input
        if not date or not amount or not category:

        """, (self.user_id, date, amount, category))
        self.conn.commit()

        # Update income listbox
        self.income_listbox.insert(tk.END, f"{date} - {amount} - {category}")

    def settings(self):
        # Get user input

        # Validate user input
        if not budget:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Please fill in budget")
            return

        try:

            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Invalid budget")
            return

        # Update budget in database
        self.cursor.execute("""
            UPDATE users SET budget = ? WHERE id = ?
        """, (budget, self.user_id))

        self.root.mainloop()
